reason: Implements the fact tier's store: SqlFactStore (nora/infra/sql/facts.py) satisfies DreamSink (DEC-130) plus a new FactReader read protocol (nora/domain/ports.py, standing_facts/fact_by_id) over the fact table from migration 0025. Three fact-tier-specific refusals live here, not on the port: propose isinstance-checks Proposal.payload against FactVerdict and raises TypeError on anything else; a not_covered verdict writes no row (silence adds nothing, removes nothing - R-53's write-level half); supersede raises ValueError on a null replaced_by, because fact's (superseded_by is null) = (superseded_at is null) CHECK requires a successor, even though the port itself permits a null one for tiers like notes that legitimately have none. Amends the still-unapplied, still-dormant 0025_fact_tier migration in place (same pattern as the warrant-axis amendment) to add supersede_source, a nullable column carrying DreamSink.supersede's own optional source/citation argument, with fact_supersede_source_is_timed_check enforcing it only ever accompanies an actual supersession. InMemoryFactStore and fact_proposal_factory (nora/testing/fact_store.py) are the same tier's domain-only double and Proposal builder, for another session's contract suite to use when proving a foreign payload is refused. tests/contract/test_dream_sink_contract.py gains SqlFactStore as its second DreamSink implementation, with the fixture, proposal construction, and row read-back all restructured per-implementation so a third implementation (e.g. a note store) can join without inheriting fact-tier vocabulary. Still no adaptor and no Dreamer runtime wiring - dormant, no code path reachable by users.
